reports.title: Tenable Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, we currently expect:
•Revenue in the range of $277.0 million to $280.0 million
•Non-GAAP income from operations in the range of $67.1 million to $70.1 million
•Non-GAAP net income in the range of $63.6 million to $66.6 million, assuming interest expense of $1.9 million, interest income of $3.8 million and a provision for income taxes of $4.6 million
•Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in the range of $0.56 to $0.58
•114.0 million diluted weighted average shares outstanding
